name: TCL 43P615
summary: TCL 43P615 ships with TCL analytics, pushed promos and a cleaner that tracks use. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This UK and EU set runs Android TV 11 and ships with TCL analytics, home screen recommendation rows, partner app attribution and a partner app auto installer. TCL also pushes content to the home screen at boot, sends messages and promos, and includes a retail demo sticker, a TGuard cleaner that tracks device use, a TCL account centre and TCL IoT.

The list was applied in six batches with a screenshot after each, then verified over three reboots with an identical final state. Wi-Fi, the D-pad, the Inputs menu, Live TV, the Play Store and the remote's app, Input and Settings buttons all worked. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV and the TCL input service for tuner and HDMI
The remote's app, Input and Settings buttons
notes: The owner used the TV Bro browser, so the preinstalled browsers are on the list. Switch them back on in the app if you use them.
One TCL service can switch partner apps back on at boot. The list turns it off.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 43P615?
faq.a: Not with the default list. It turns off Google Assistant, the TCL voice service and the microphone manager. Switch them back on in the app if you use voice.
The list turns off Miracast screen mirroring and the MagiConnect companion. Switch them back on in the app if you cast that way.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Android TV home screen back.
